facts.fact: The paper says the National Committee for Digital Transformation, established in 2022, marked a renewed effort to develop a comprehensive digital strategy, emphasising regulatory reform, capacity building, infrastructure and citizen participation, with a target for implementation by 2030, citing the General Information Authority (2022).

systems.system: digital strategy of the National Committee for Digital Transformation
systems.owner: National Committee for Digital Transformation; General Information Authority

note: Class left empty: the paper names the strategy and a 2030 target and lists its emphases but says nothing of adoption by the whole government; 'drafting' is the closest value for a committee set up in 2022 to develop it.
